messages:
alex: FYI PR #47299 blocked — staging integ failing on `integration::model-routing::shard7`. Merge queue paused.
maria: on it. is it a consistent regression or flaky? any error snippets?
alex: looks intermittent. log snippet:
```
E: expected 200 but got 503
at tests/integration/routing_test.go:256
note: kv cache miss -> backend timeout
```
sam: @maria can you kick a targeted rerun for shard7? if it flakes again we should bisect.
maria: doing targeted: `/ci rerun --pr 47299 --shard=staging-integ-7 --targeted`
ci-bot: Started targeted run (build 47299.8) for pr=47299 shard=staging-integ-7 — https://ci.redwood.example/build/47299.8 :dart:
maria: I saw a green run locally once on my machine but want CI confirmation.
jordan: reminder: mergebot requires 2 approvals + green CI. we currently have 1 approval (alex). need one more reviewer.
alex: pinging reviewers. @sam could you eyeball after rerun?
sam: will do. if it fails again I'll start bisecting the commit range from the last deploy.
ci-bot: Run complete: 47299.8 — FAILED (1 test) — failing test: integration::model-routing::shard7
ci-bot: Failure excerpt: `Timeout waiting for backend response (500ms) after kv-cache miss` — full logs: https://ci.redwood.example/build/47299.8/logs
maria: same transient timeout. my hunch: shard7 infra noise or a recent tweak to routing backoff.
jordan: can we try a canary pool to rule out pool-specific infra? try `staging-canary-2`.
alex: yep, please run `/ci rerun --pr 47299 --pool=staging-canary-2`.
maria: kicking it off.
ci-bot: Started run (build 47299.9) for pr=47299 pool=staging-canary-2 — https://ci.redwood.example/build/47299.9
maria: also repro'd a pass locally after increasing synthetic timeouts, but we shouldn't change test timeouts just yet.
ci-bot: Run complete: 47299.9 — PASSED ✅
alex: interesting — canary pool passed while staging-integ failed. points to shard7 instability.
sam: given canary green I'm ok approving if we annotate the PR with the infra ticket and canary pass. also we should schedule follow-up on shard7.
jordan: agree. file an infra ticket and ping oncall for shard7.
alex: done — INF-1382 created with logs + build links. linked in PR.
maria: update the PR description with INF-1382 and the canary run link and I will +1.
sam: adding my approval now — LGTM.
mergebot: Merge blocked: required checks failing on staging-integ. To override use `/merge override-ci` with manager ack.
jordan: prefer not to force. plan: rerun staging-integ during off-peak; if it passes twice in a row we merge.
maria: scheduling another targeted rerun in 45m: `/ci schedule-rerun --pr 47299 --shard=staging-integ-7 --at 03:15 UTC`.
ci-bot: Scheduled run for 47299 at 03:15 UTC — will report back.
alex: noted. PR merge plan: if staging-integ reports 2 consecutive green targeted runs -> merge. otherwise hold and escalate INF-1382.
maria: will post results from scheduled run here.
alex: thanks all. if it keeps failing and no owner steps in, I'll start a bisect next shift. :thumbsup:
